title: BIM Coordination
description:
This project was developed during an 8-month academic studio. Our team rehabilitated the historic Gary Methodist Church, adaptively reusing portions of the structure as senior housing. The primary goals of the design were Passive House performance, climate resiliency, and strengthening community ties within the city.

My service:
1. Led sustainability and daylighting analysis to optimize building performance and meet Passive House targets.
2. Developed architectural design strategies for the adaptive reuse of the existing church structure into senior housing.
3. Reviewed zoning laws and building codes to ensure the design met all regulatory requirements.
4. Collaborated with a teammate to analyze structural loads and determine framework requirements for integrating new program into the existing building.
team: Paul Yang, Druthi Padamati, Mithuna Kandasamy
